input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: Deepen (flagship 4) changepoint-detector: a real series with documented carry-forward for the stale-feed test

errors.what: run 1 of the pre-registered check could not score B1: the shipped smallestStep took a float-noise difference (7e-15) as the tick
errors.fix: floatNoise rule in update-rate.mjs; run 2 the same script and bars; run 1 kept as eval/stale-real-trades-run1.out.txt

doc_friction.issue: changepoint-detector next: sat at 1998 of 2000 characters, so any edit parks an item; the row reads as a history log more than a queue
7,900 lines; finding the stale-feed rounds took grep, not the README's own structure

deviations.why: the pre-registered run 1 hit a product bug (tick from float noise) that left B1 unscorable; reran once after the fix with the same script and bars rather than reporting B1 as unscorable
deviations.did: kept run 1's output, disclosed the rerun in the README, the post and the PR
deviations.result: B2 failed identically in both runs, so the rerun could not have turned the verdict into a pass

notes: Data: R package highfrequency trade samples (GPL>=2, fetched via eval/hf-trades-fetch.py, not committed). Run 2: Europe B1 84/85 pass, B2 56/56 fail, B3 112/119 pass; 98 min on 4 threads. Post hoc: no catch-up growth in prints; the test rewards excess exact repeats above one tick, so the one-tick gate stays. 112 update-rate-related tests pass after the floatNoise fix.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: a statistician finding a labelled real dataset, writing and pre-registering the check, debugging the tick bug and writing it up

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
